title: prometheus-mcp-hub values
description: Values for the prometheus-mcp-hub chart. additionalProperties is false at the top level on purpose: a mistyped top-level key in a chart deployed to a fleet is a silent default, not an error, and that is exactly the failure this schema exists to catch. There is no persistence section and no PVC: all durable hub state lives in two Kubernetes Secrets the hub reads and writes itself.

global.description: Reserved for Helm global values. This chart reads nothing from it.

nameOverride.description: Override the chart name used in resource names.

fullnameOverride.description: Override the fully qualified name of every rendered object.

namespaceOverride.description: Render every object into this namespace instead of .Release.Namespace.

commonLabels.description: Extra labels added to every rendered object.

commonAnnotations.description: Extra annotations added to every rendered object.

registry.description: Image registry. Empty means the repository is fully qualified already.

repository.description: Hub image repository, without the registry.

tag.description: Image tag. Empty means .Chart.AppVersion. Ignored when digest is set.

digest.description: Image digest. When set the image is pinned by digest and the tag is ignored.

imagePullSecrets.description: Image pull secrets for a private registry.

replicaCount.description: Number of hub replicas. A spoke tunnel is pinned to one replica and there is deliberately no hub-to-hub forwarding, so above 1 every replica must be individually routable and every spoke must list all of them.

rollingUpdate.description: spec.strategy.rollingUpdate. Empty means the Kubernetes defaults.

name.description: Name of the ServiceAccount. Empty means the chart fullname.

automountServiceAccountToken.description: Mount the projected token. The hub REQUIRES this with state.backend=secret: it reads and writes its own state Secret through the Kubernetes API.

rbac.description: Namespaced RBAC. Nothing cluster-scoped is ever rendered by this chart.

create.description: Render the Role and RoleBinding over the hub's own Secrets.

allowCreate.description: Grant the unrestricted `create` verb on Secrets in this namespace. Kubernetes cannot restrict `create` by resourceNames, so this one verb cannot be name-scoped. It permits creating a Secret, never reading one.

extraSecretNames.description: Extra resourceNames appended to the name-restricted Secret rule.

state.description: Durable state. There is no database and no PVC.

backend.description: PMF_STATE_BACKEND. `secret` is production; `file` writes one JSON file on the /tmp emptyDir and LOSES every credential on restart, which orphans every spoke.

secretName.description: PMF_STATE_SECRET_NAME. Empty means <fullname>-state. This exact name is what the Role restricts by resourceNames.

caSecretName.description: PMF_CA_SECRET_NAME. Empty means <fullname>-ca. Separate from the state Secret so the two have different blast radii.

file.description: PMF_STATE_FILE. Only used when state.backend is file.

bootstrap.description: Operator-supplied CA material and HMAC pepper, adopted from a Secret this chart does NOT create, so no key material passes through Helm values.

existingSecret.description: Name of the existing Secret. Empty disables the whole block.

pepperKey.description: Key holding the HMAC pepper. Empty leaves PMF_PEPPER_FILE unset.

caCertKey.description: Key holding the PEM CA certificate. Must be set with caKeyKey.

caKeyKey.description: Key holding the PEM CA private key. Must be set with caCertKey.

podLabels.description: Extra labels for the hub pods.

podSecurityContext.description: Pod-level securityContext. runAsUser/runAsGroup/fsGroup accept null so an OpenShift SCC can assign IDs from the namespace range; runAsNonRoot and the seccomp profile are not negotiable.

runAsNonRoot.description: Refuse to start any container in the pod as UID 0.

runAsUser.description: Pod UID. null lets an OpenShift SCC assign one.

runAsGroup.description: Pod GID. null lets an OpenShift SCC assign one.

fsGroup.description: Supplemental filesystem group. null on OpenShift.

localhostProfile.description: Profile path when type is Localhost.

allowPrivilegeEscalation.description: Disallow gaining more privileges than the parent.

readOnlyRootFilesystem.description: Read-only root filesystem; /tmp is the one writable path.

privileged.description: Privileged container. Never set this true.

add.description: Capabilities to add; keep this empty.

resources.description: Compute resources. There is deliberately no default CPU limit: CFS-throttling a process terminating ~100 long-lived spoke tunnels turns a CPU spike into fleet-wide latency.

cpu.description: CPU limit. Deliberately unset by default.

memory.description: Memory limit; also the source of GOMEMLIMIT.

memLimit.description: Set GOMEMLIMIT from resources.limits.memory via the downward API.

memLimitRatio.description: Fraction of the memory limit used for GOMEMLIMIT.

tmpDirSizeLimit.description: sizeLimit of the /tmp emptyDir that makes readOnlyRootFilesystem workable.

ports.description: Container ports. There is no tunnel port: the tunnel is a WebSocket on the MCP listener (ADR-0014).

admin.description: Admin REST, metrics, health and pprof (PMF_ADMIN_ADDR). NEVER routed through an Ingress and never carried by a LoadBalancer or NodePort Service; the chart fails to render if you try.

config.description: PMF_ configuration. Every key maps to one flag in internal/config/hub.go.

dataDir.description: PMF_DATA_DIR. Scratch only; it is the /tmp emptyDir and must stay under /tmp.

trustDomain.description: PMF_TRUST_DOMAIN. Appears in every spoke certificate URI SAN; changing it invalidates every issued spoke certificate.

maxResponseBudgetBytes.description: PMF_MAX_RESPONSE_BUDGET_BYTES. Must not be below maxResponseBytes or no single response could ever complete.

pprofEnabled.description: PMF_PPROF_ENABLED. Exposes /debug/pprof on the admin listener.

enableStatusConfig.description: PMF_ENABLE_STATUS_CONFIG. Off by default: scrape configurations routinely embed credentials, and this hub hands output to an AI agent.

publicURL.description: PMF_PUBLIC_URL. Canonical external MCP URL for the OAuth PRM document.

endpoint.description: PMF_OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT. Required when tracing.enabled is true.

sampleRatio.description: PMF_TRACE_SAMPLE_RATIO, as a string so YAML never reformats it.

service.description: MCP + admin Service. Must stay ClusterIP while service.admin.enabled is true.

labels.description: Extra labels for the MCP Service.

sessionAffinity.description: The MCP transport is stateless, so None is correct.

ipFamilyPolicy.description: spec.ipFamilyPolicy. Empty means the cluster default.

admin.description: Admin/metrics port on the ClusterIP Service.

enabled.description: Publish the admin/metrics port so a ServiceMonitor can scrape it.

tunnel.description: The spoke tunnel, which is a WebSocket on the MCP listener rather than a listener of its own. An Ingress terminates TLS and cannot pass a client certificate through, so mutual authentication happens inside the connection over the spoke's certificate; the Ingress is a plain proxy and verifies nothing (ADR-0014).

path.description: PMF_TUNNEL_PATH. Path on the MCP listener where spokes open the tunnel WebSocket. A spoke's hub.endpoints entry is wss://<ingress host><tunnel.path>. It may not be "/", which would swallow the MCP endpoint; the binary refuses that too.

ingress.description: Standard networking.k8s.io/v1 Ingress for the MCP port, which publishes BOTH the agent-facing MCP endpoint and the spoke tunnel WebSocket at tunnel.path. A path that does not cover tunnel.path gets a second rule rendered automatically.

enabled.description: Render the Ingress. It carries MCP and the spoke tunnel alike; there is no second Service and no ssl-passthrough to arrange.

annotations.description: Annotations for the Ingress. Idle timeouts matter here: the tunnel is a long-lived WebSocket and a controller that closes idle upgraded connections below ~30s disconnects the whole fleet. nginx's 60s default is fine against the tunnel's 10s keepalive pings; raise it with nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-read-timeout where a controller is stricter.

host.description: Hostname. Required when ingress.enabled is true.

path.description: Path exposed. "/" publishes MCP and the tunnel together. A narrower path that does not cover tunnel.path causes a second path entry to be rendered for the tunnel.

servicePortName.description: Name of the Service port to route to. Must be `mcp`. This is deliberately NOT a schema enum: the template's own check explains why the admin port must never be routed and that the mcp port carries the spoke tunnel too, and that message is worth more than a one-line schema rejection.

extraHosts.description: Additional hosts, each with host and optionally path and pathType.

secretName.description: Secret holding the serving certificate. Empty with enabled: true means the controller's default certificate -- unless certManager.enabled is true, in which case this is wired automatically to the Secret cert-manager writes.

hosts.description: Override the hosts listed in the TLS block.

certManager.description: cert-manager resources. It supplies the hub's SERVING certificate and nothing else. The hub's internal CA is NOT a cert-manager Certificate: it signs spoke identities, so the hub must hold its private key, and it is generated on first boot into the CA Secret the hub owns. Spoke certificates come from the hub's enrollment API for the same reason. Every resource is guarded by the cert-manager.io/v1 capability, and certManager.enabled on a cluster without the CRDs is a render-time failure.

enabled.description: Render cert-manager resources. Requires the cert-manager.io/v1 CRDs.

issuerRef.description: The existing Issuer or ClusterIssuer that signs the hub's serving certificate. The chart never creates one.

serving.description: The hub's serving certificate, wired to ingress.tls.secretName automatically.

secretName.description: Secret cert-manager writes to. Empty means <fullname>-serving-tls.

dnsNames.description: DNS names on the certificate. Empty means ingress.host plus every ingress.extraHosts entry.

duration.description: spec.duration. Empty leaves the issuer's default.

renewBefore.description: spec.renewBefore. Empty leaves the issuer's default.

secretAnnotations.description: Annotations placed on the generated Secret through spec.secretTemplate.

privateKey.description: spec.privateKey. rotationPolicy: Always issues a fresh key on renewal instead of re-signing the old one.

podDisruptionBudget.description: PodDisruptionBudget. Force-disabled whenever replicaCount < 2: minAvailable 1 on a single-replica workload blocks every node drain forever.

enabled.description: Render a PDB, subject to the replicaCount >= 2 guard.

unhealthyPodEvictionPolicy.description: Kubernetes >= 1.27. AlwaysAllow lets a broken pod be evicted.

networkPolicy.description: NetworkPolicy. On by default: the hub terminates connections from outside the cluster and holds a CA.

mcp.description: Ingress to the MCP port. This carries spoke tunnels as well as agent traffic -- both arrive on this port from the Ingress controller -- so there is no separate tunnel rule.

allowAll.description: Allow the MCP port from any source.

namespaceSelector.description: namespaceSelector for clients allowed to reach the MCP port.

podSelector.description: podSelector for clients allowed to reach the MCP port.

extraFrom.description: Additional raw ingress.from entries for the MCP port.

admin.description: Ingress to the admin/metrics port. This port is never published outside.

namespaceSelector.description: namespaceSelector for the only namespace allowed to scrape.

extraFrom.description: Additional raw ingress.from entries for the admin port.

egress.description: Hub egress: DNS, the Kubernetes API for its state Secret, and optionally OTLP.

allowKubeAPI.description: Allow egress to the Kubernetes API. Required with state.backend=secret.

kubeAPIPort.description: Port of the Kubernetes API server.

extraRules.description: Raw additional egress rules, appended verbatim.

serviceMonitor.description: Prometheus Operator ServiceMonitor. Requires the monitoring.coreos.com/v1 CRDs.

namespace.description: Namespace for the ServiceMonitor. Empty means the release namespace.

labels.description: Extra labels; must match your Prometheus' serviceMonitorSelector.

path.description: Metrics path on the admin listener.

targetLabels.description: Service labels copied onto scraped metrics.

prometheusRule.description: Prometheus Operator PrometheusRule. Every metric name in the shipped expressions comes from internal/obs/metrics.go; both *_cert_expiry_seconds gauges hold SECONDS REMAINING, not a unix timestamp.

namespace.description: Namespace for the PrometheusRule. Empty means the release namespace.

labels.description: Extra labels; must match your Prometheus' ruleSelector.

selector.description: Label matcher appended to every shipped expression. Empty means job="<name>".

additionalRuleLabels.description: Extra labels added to every shipped alert.

runbookUrlPrefix.description: Runbook URL prefix; the alert name is appended.

spokesDisconnectedRatio.description: Fraction of enrolled spokes that may be disconnected.

caCertExpirySeconds.description: Seconds of remaining CA validity below which the alert fires.

spokeCertExpirySeconds.description: Seconds of remaining spoke certificate validity.

additionalGroups.description: Extra rule groups appended verbatim to spec.groups.

autoUpdate.description: Auto-update CronJob. OFF BY DEFAULT: an automatic weekly rollout to 100 production clusters is a fleet-wide outage delivery mechanism. When enabled it is digest-pinned, cosign signature- and provenance-verified, staggered by a hash of the release identity and split into cohorts.

enabled.description: Render the auto-update CronJob and its Role, RoleBinding and ServiceAccount.

schedule.description: Explicit cron schedule. Empty derives one from a hash of the release identity.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone for the schedule (Kubernetes >= 1.27).

cohort.description: Release cohort: canary accepts a promotion immediately, early after 72h, stable after 7 days. It also shifts the derived weekday.

channelTag.description: Moving OCI tag the updater resolves to a digest. Never written into the pod spec.

pinned.description: Refuse to patch anything, while still running verification.

identity.description: Extra string mixed into the stagger hash. Empty means release name plus namespace.

backoffLimit.description: Job backoffLimit. 0: a failed verified rollout must not be retried blindly.

ttlSecondsAfterFinished.description: Job ttlSecondsAfterFinished. Empty string means unset.

image.description: Updater image. It must provide a POSIX shell plus kubectl, cosign, crane and jq; the hub image is distroless and has none of them.

registry.description: Image registry. Empty means the repository is fully qualified already.

tag.description: Image tag. Empty means .Chart.AppVersion. Ignored when digest is set.

digest.description: Image digest. When set the image is pinned by digest and the tag is ignored.

certificateOidcIssuer.description: OIDC issuer that must have signed the image.

certificateIdentityRegexp.description: Regex the signing certificate's SAN identity must match. Narrow, never ".*".

rekorURL.description: Rekor transparency log URL. Empty uses cosign's default public instance.

rolloutTimeout.description: kubectl rollout status timeout; on expiry the job runs rollout undo.

resources.description: Compute resources. The updater is short-lived.

cpu.description: CPU limit. Deliberately unset by default.

memory.description: Memory limit; also the source of GOMEMLIMIT.

podSecurityContext.description: Pod securityContext for the update job.

containerSecurityContext.description: Container securityContext for the update job.

scratchSizeLimit.description: sizeLimit of the writable scratch emptyDir cosign and crane need.

nodeSelector.description: Node selector for the update job.

extraEnv.description: Extra environment variables for the update job, in raw EnvVar form.

image.description: Image for the `helm test` pod. It needs wget.

registry.description: Image registry. Empty means the repository is fully qualified already.

tag.description: Image tag. Empty means .Chart.AppVersion. Ignored when digest is set.

digest.description: Image digest. When set the image is pinned by digest and the tag is ignored.

extraEnv.description: Extra environment variables for the hub container, in raw EnvVar form. The only supported way to set a PMF_ key this chart does not model.

extraEnvFrom.description: Extra envFrom sources for the hub container.

extraVolumeMounts.description: Extra volume mounts for the hub container.

extraArgs.description: Extra arguments appended to the command line. Flags beat environment.

dnsPolicy.description: spec.template.spec.dnsPolicy. Empty means the cluster default.

restartOnConfigChange.description: Roll the pods when the rendered ConfigMap changes.

startupProbe.description: Startup probe on /healthz, served by the admin listener.

livenessProbe.description: Liveness probe on /healthz, which never checks a dependency, served by the admin listener.

readinessProbe.description: Readiness probe on /readyz, served by the admin listener.

extraManifests.description: Extra manifests rendered verbatim, each passed through tpl.
